name: Improved Marching Cubes with New Table and Displacement
aliases: Improved Marching Cubes (MC) with New Table and Displacement
definition: A variant of Marching Cubes that improves worst-case triangle quality by using a modified MC table that avoids specific edge groups responsible for poor triangles, combined with a non-linear displacement of cut points on edges.
summary: Improved Marching Cubes with New Table and Displacement enhances worst-case triangle quality by modifying the lookup table to exclude poor edge groups and applying non-linear displacement to edge intersections.
